sections.bio:
Hey, I’m ISTIAK, SaaS Founder, Product Hunt Launch Strategist, Hunter, and B2B Growth Marketer.

Since 2017, I’ve been building, launching, and marketing digital products while working directly with SaaS founders, entrepreneurs, marketers, and startup teams around the world.

🚀 As an active Product Hunt hunter and launch strategist, I’ve helped products reach #1, #2, #3, #4, and #5 Product of the Day.

More importantly for brands, my network is naturally built around the people who discover, evaluate, recommend, and buy digital products.

Through Product Hunt and my broader professional network, I regularly engage with founders, SaaS builders, marketers, growth professionals, early adopters, and tech enthusiasts. These are people actively looking for new tools that can help them build, market, sell, automate, and grow.

That makes my audience especially relevant for  SaaS, AI, B2B software, sales & marketing tools, productivity products, and other digital-first brands.

I don't want brand partnerships to feel like random advertisements. I prefer products that genuinely fit my audience, so I can introduce them through practical insights, real use cases, and conversations that feel natural to my network.

I don't just create content around digital products, I work, build, launch, and network inside the ecosystem that buys them.
